corr.color.help: Corrects colors against a standard 24-chip card (ColorChecker type). The card orientation is detected automatically.

corr.distortion.failed: Calibration failed: corners found in {used} of {total} images (at least 3 needed).
corr.distortion.help: Select photos of a chessboard taken with the same camera and lens (min. 3, ideally 8-15 from different angles), or load an existing .npz.
corr.intro: Optional. Applied in memory, in this order, whenever an image is opened.
corr.perspective.help: Needs 4 ArUco markers (DICT_4X4_50) with IDs 0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-right, 3 bottom-left. The image is straightened without stretching. If you enter the real distances between marker centers, the scale (mm/px) is also computed for each image.
corr.perspective.use_scale: Use as scale for each image
corr.skip_aruco: Perspective correction is on but ArUco markers {ids} were not found. The image is not analyzed.
corr.skip_summary: {n} images were skipped because they lack the 4 ArUco markers. They are marked with ⚠ in the list.

param.objects.area_max.label: Maximum area ({unit})
param.objects.area_max.tip:
Larger objects are ignored.
In mm² when there is a scale; otherwise in px².
param.objects.area_min.label: Minimum area ({unit})
param.objects.area_min.tip:
Smaller objects are ignored (dust, debris).
In mm² when there is a scale; otherwise in px².
param.objects.exclude_border.label: Exclude border objects
param.objects.exclude_border.tip: Ignores objects cut by the image border.
param.objects.filters.label: Object filters
param.objects.filters.tip: Minimum and maximum object size, and whether objects cut by the image border are ignored.
param.objects.harmonics.label: Harmonics
param.objects.hdr_measure.label: MEASUREMENTS
param.objects.hdr_objects.label: OBJECTS
param.objects.measure_color.label: Color
param.objects.measure_color.tip: Mean color and dominant colors (KMeans) per object and per image.
param.objects.measure_count.label: Count
param.objects.measure_count.tip: Counts the objects and marks each one with a dot: two dots on one object = split; no dot = not counted.
param.objects.measure_shape.label: Shape
param.objects.measure_shape.tip:
Elliptic Fourier descriptors of each object: the outline without size or rotation,
to compare shapes and compute the mean shape.
param.objects.measure_size.label: Morphometry
param.objects.measure_size.tip:
Size and shape of each object: area, length, width, perimeter, circularity, solidity, etc.
Objects that touched others are counted but not measured.
param.objects.measure_touching.label: Also measure touching objects
param.objects.measure_touching.tip: By default only separate objects are measured: the outline of touching objects is not reliable.
param.objects.n_colors.label: Colors per object
param.objects.touching.label: Objects touch each other
param.objects.touching.tip:
Turn on if objects touch: they are declumped.
Leave off for separate or irregular objects (flowers, leaves).
